about.heading: About
about.body: I'm a final-year BSc (Hons) IT student at SLIIT with hands-on experience across full-stack and microservices development. My work spans banking backend systems, event-driven architecture with Kafka, and full MERN-stack platforms — I care about building things that hold up outside a classroom, not just demo well once.

projects.name: Toy Store
projects.description: Microservices System , Multi-service e-commerce backend built on event-driven architecture — separate Product, Inventory, Order, and Base services communicating asynchronously via Kafka.

projects.name: Nutique
projects.description: Hamper & Gifting E-Commerce Platform- Full-stack e-commerce platform for a real hamper and gifting business. Customers browse a product catalogue, build custom gift hampers, or buy pre-made ones, then check out via a WhatsApp-based order flow instead of a payment gateway. Includes JWT-secured admin panel for managing inventory, pricing, and orders, plus centralized exception handling for clean API error responses.
